utilities.name: Giovanna Manroad
utilities.notes:
Stole from a prince. Jumped out da window. Landed on hay. Very nice horse. Pet the horse and vows to create a genuine connection with every horse she meets.

When I was young both my parents drowned in a boating accident. I studied why this occured and learned that water is evil. I started a new religion and I conned followers for years, and used grift and stole all the money and left them hanging. As a result of this formative experience, I am skilled at conning and persuading fools.
